title: Rounded hexagon
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first two-dimensional sketch, draw the first face consisting of two loops. For the first loop, draw a square using four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0417, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.0417, 0.0) and ends at (0.0417, 0.0417). The third line starts at (0.0417, 0.0417) and ends at (0.0, 0.0417). The fourth line completes the square by starting at (0.0, 0.0417) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0).

For the second loop, draw a rounded hexagon using four arcs and four lines. The first arc starts at (0.0014, 0.0027), has a midpoint at (0.0018, 0.0018), and ends at (0.0027, 0.0014). The first line starts at (0.0027, 0.0014) and ends at (0.039, 0.0014). The second arc starts at (0.039, 0.0014), has a midpoint at (0.0399, 0.0018), and ends at (0.0403, 0.0027). The second line starts at (0.0403, 0.0027) and ends at (0.0403, 0.039). The third arc starts at (0.0403, 0.039), has a midpoint at (0.0399, 0.0399), and ends at (0.039, 0.0403). The third line starts at (0.039, 0.0403) and ends at (0.0027, 0.0403). The fourth arc starts at (0.0027, 0.0403), has a midpoint at (0.0018, 0.0399), and ends at (0.0014, 0.039). The fourth line completes the hexagon by starting at (0.0014, 0.039) and ending at (0.0014, 0.0027).

Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0417. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles set to zero and translate it using a translation vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units in the direction of the normal to generate the three-dimensional model. Ensure the final part has a length of 0.04166666666666666 units, a width of 0.04166666666666666 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the hexagonal base
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0417, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0417, 0.0417) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0417) \
     .close()

# Create the rounded top
r = r.moveTo(0.0014, 0.0027) \
     .threePointArc((0.0018, 0.0018), (0.0027, 0.0014)) \
     .lineTo(0.039, 0.0014) \
     .threePointArc((0.0399, 0.0018), (0.0403, 0.0027)) \
     .lineTo(0.0403, 0.039) \
     .threePointArc((0.0399, 0.0399), (0.039, 0.0403)) \
     .lineTo(0.0027, 0.0403) \
     .threePointArc((0.0018, 0.0399), (0.0014, 0.039)) \
     .lineTo(0.0014, 0.0027) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# Overall dimensions
s = 0.0417   # square cross-section size (X and Y)
h = 0.75     # length (Z)
R = 0.006    # corner fillet radius on the vertical edges

# Mid-point of the quarter-circle fillet arc
m = R * (1 - math.sqrt(2) / 2)

# Sketch the rounded-square cross-section and extrude
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, R)
    .threePointArc((m, m), (R, 0))
    .lineTo(s - R, 0)
    .threePointArc((s - m, m), (s, R))
    .lineTo(s, s - R)
    .threePointArc((s - m, s - m), (s - R, s))
    .lineTo(R, s)
    .threePointArc((m, s - m), (0, s - R))
    .close()
    .extrude(h)
)
